reader.title: Article
reader.desc: This surface renders only published post records (status=published). Body remains Markdown at rest and is sanitized at render time.
preview.title: Preview
preview.notice: Draft preview — this record is not public.
preview.published-hint: Published. The draft copy is still in studio drafts — remove it when done.
preview.preview-delete-msg: The record stays in the archive with status deleted (soft delete).
about.title: About ArcBlog
about.desc: ArcBlog is a Blocklet blog: DID Wallet identity is the author credential, posts are Markdown-first, and images live in the Arc file space.
about.lifecycle-desc: Posts follow a draft → published → archived lifecycle with optimistic concurrency and a full audit trail. Soft deletes keep records recoverable.
author.title: Author
author.desc: Who publishes here: this node's DID-bound author identity.
index.hero-desc: Only published stories appear in the public feed. Every post remains DID-attributed and follows a draft → published → archived lifecycle.
page-view.title: Page
pages-admin.created-ok: Page created offline. Bring it online when ready.
reader.paid-notice: This is a paid article. The full text is released after purchase — it is never shipped to your browser before that.
store.title: Creator store
store.desc: Digital goods published by this node. The creator sets the price; buying happens with a DID wallet.
store.empty: No public products yet. Add one: node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs product add --id <id> --creator-did <did> --price-amount <n>
store.howto-desc: A purchase is an Order paid through the configured adapter; settlement then splits the amount (creator / Hub / protocol), and a paid article unlocks through an Access Grant. This page is the catalogue only — there is no checkout here.

console.access-admin-grants-empty: Created automatically when a paid reading order settles.
console.admin-admin-archive-msg: This writes an archived copy to private drafts. The public post stays live until you remove it from public.
console.admin-admin-delete-msg: The record stays in drafts with status deleted and can be republished later.
console.admin-admin-publish-msg: This publishes the current draft record. Deleted records can be republished.
console.admin-admin-unpublish-msg: Archive first keeps a copy in drafts. Removing from public deletes the original from public posts.
console.admin-content-empty: Nothing here yet. Write your first post.
console.admin-gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view node health, Hubs, economy and agent state.
console.admin-lifecycle-desc: Archive copies a post to the private drafts directory; Remove from public takes it off the public feed. Drafts can be published or soft-deleted from the row actions.
console.admin-studio-desc: Manage drafts, published stories, archived stories, and uploaded media from one wallet-bound workspace.
console.agent-admin-admin-only: Sign in as an administrator to see this list.
console.agent-admin-agent-closed: Default-closed (spec §130): settle_payment, change_wallet, change_role never run from the agent surface.
console.agent-admin-agent-grants-empty: How to grant one: node scripts/arcblog-agent.mjs authorize --agent <did> --capability agent.write --ttl 30
console.agent-admin-desc: Time-boxed capability grants issued to agents.
console.agent-admin-gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view node health, Hubs, economy and agent state.
console.agent-admin-mutations: This console reports state only. Value-bearing mutations (settlement, wallets, roles, payments) stay deliberate CLI actions with a DID session.
console.appearance-desc: Theme, tone and palette for this site. Admins set the defaults; signed-in users can personalize their own theme.
console.appearance-gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to set this site's palette and tone. Signed-in users can also personalize their own theme.

console.hub-admin-approve-msg: The relation becomes indexed. Only meaningful for applied relations.
console.hub-admin-cli-desc: Relation ids are derived from the Hub DID by hashing, which the UI cannot compute — add a Studio and rebuild the index with:
console.hub-admin-desc: Studio ↔ Hub relations and the derived content index. Indexing is the Hub's sovereignty: it only ever carries metadata, never the source body.
console.hub-admin-gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to curate Studios and the content index.
console.hub-admin-index-empty: Index is empty. Rebuild: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs hub index rebuild
console.hub-admin-purge-msg: Deletes the tombstone entirely. Prefer Terminate for auditability.
console.hub-admin-reject-msg: The relation becomes a removed tombstone (kept for audit). Either side may terminate.
console.hub-admin-relations-empty: No relations yet. A Studio applies with: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs hub register --hub-did <did>
console.hub-admin-relations-legend: applied = awaiting review · indexed = live · removed = terminated (Tombstone kept) · freshness fresh/stale/never/offline (derived by `hub refresh`; offline = last sync failed)
